items.explanation: || returns NULL if any part is NULL; CONCAT treats NULL as empty.
items.example: SELECT first_name || ' ' || last_name AS full_name, CONCAT(title_of_courtesy, ' ', last_name) AS formal FROM employees;
SELECT UPPER(company_name), LOWER(city) FROM customers LIMIT 5;

items.explanation: Counts characters (CHAR_LENGTH is the standard name).
items.example: SELECT product_name, LENGTH(product_name) AS len FROM products ORDER BY len DESC LIMIT 5;

items.syntax: SUBSTRING(s FROM start FOR len), LEFT(s, n)
items.example: SELECT company_name, LEFT(company_name, 3) AS code, SUBSTRING(company_name FROM 2 FOR 4) AS mid FROM customers LIMIT 5;

items.explanation: Returns the nth piece, or '' when missing (PostgreSQL).
items.example: SELECT contact_name, SPLIT_PART(contact_name, ' ', 1) AS first, SPLIT_PART(contact_name, ' ', 2) AS last FROM customers LIMIT 5;
items.expected: Contact names split into first and last.

items.example: SELECT contact_name, POSITION(' ' IN contact_name) AS space_at FROM customers LIMIT 5;

items.explanation: REPLACE swaps every occurrence; TRIM strips leading and trailing spaces.
items.example: SELECT product_name, REPLACE(product_name, ' ', '_') AS slug, TRIM('  x  ') AS trimmed FROM products LIMIT 5;
SELECT postal_code FROM customers WHERE postal_code ~ '^[0-9]+$' LIMIT 5;

items.explanation: Pads to a fixed width; ::text casts a number to string.
items.example: SELECT order_id, LPAD(order_id::text, 6, '0') AS padded FROM orders LIMIT 5;
